answer: The ridge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pearl. Reaching the umber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
